messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm trying to onboard NEO-7B-lite for the reranker flow. Weights uploaded here: ```s3://redwood-models/neo/neo-7b-lite/v1/weights.bin``` Can folks check license/tokenizer/config before I kick off the serving job?

maria: thanks — will scan license now. Do we have a model_card attached? I need it for the compliance gate.

alex: not yet, just the weights + small README. I can drop a draft model_card in the bucket but wanted to flag any immediate tokenization oddities first.

license-bot: Automated scan result: model_card not present. Detected license metadata in repo: "NC-BY-1.0" -> NON-COMMERCIAL use only. Flag: requires Legal review before hosted/dedicated serving.

maria: ^^^ this. If it's NC we can't make it available on Hosted API or Dedicated for customers without special approval. Private deployments possible but still need attribution text + usage restrictions in onboarding flow.

tyler: ran a quick tokenizer pass with our current huggingface tokenizer config. Two quirks: (1) tokenizer special tokens missing BOS token — causes leading-space shifts for prompts. (2) tokenizer vocab uses byte-level merges that produce unusually long token for emoji, e.g. 😅 -> single token. I can paste the small failing snippet: ```>>> tok.encode("Hello") [101, 102, ...] >>> tok.encode(" Hello") != shifted outputs``` Might break prompt-aware caching.

samir: re: tokenizer — we can patch a TokenizerAdapter that inserts a BOS on encode at serving time. That will keep embeddings alignment. But we should note this in the model_card and tests.

tyler: also config validation failed in CI for `serving-config.yaml` — reason: `kv_cache_enabled: true` + `quantize: int4` combo currently unsupported for this arch. Error log: ```ValidationError: KV cache + int4 not supported for fused-attn kernel on A100x```

alex: ok noted. If KV cache must be off we lose some throughput for long contexts. Is fallback to CPU KV possible?

samir: fallback exists but latency hit. Recommend we try `kv_cache_enabled: false` for initial rollout, add a toggle in console for customers. Ops can enable KV for Dedicated later after kernel/quantization work.

jen (legal): I'm jumping in — NC-BY is a showstopper for any customer-facing hosted offering. We need full model_card, source provenance, and explicit attribution text. Legal needs: (a) confirm training data sources (b) confirm that downstream commercial use is not allowed (or clarify license) (c) approval for internal evals. I can queue this but need the model_card + link to weights + any vendor agreement.

alex: thanks Jen. I'll upload a draft model_card by EOD with provenance notes. For now we'll mark hosted API as blocked.

maria: action items I think: 1) alex uploads model_card + link to weights (owner: alex) 2) tyler adds tokenizer adapter + unit test (owner: tyler) 3) samir sets serving-config to `kv_cache_enabled: false` and creates a follow-up issue to re-enable (owner: samir) 4) jen files legal review ticket and posts outcome (owner: jen).

alex: sounds good. I'll also add a short attribution snippet to the onboarding flow: "Model: NEO-7B-lite (NC-BY-1.0) — attribution required; commercial use restricted."

license-bot: Created ticket LIC-2019 for legal review (assigned: jen). Status: pending.

tyler: I'll push a tiny PR for the TokenizerAdapter and a failing test that demonstrates the BOS/shift behavior. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/neo-tokenizer-adapter/pull/42

samir: created infra change to default kv_cache=false for this model id in staging routing. CI config updated.

maria: small note on telemetry: flag this model in evals as "license-restricted" so Optimize suggestions don't recommend it for cost-driven upgrades.

jen (legal): we accept the ticket. If training data includes public web crawl only and no restricted sources, we can usually approve internal evals. Commercial deployment requires explicit license change or vendor approval. Will update LIC-2019 once review complete.

alex: great — marking thread as tracking for onboarding. I'll follow up when model_card is uploaded. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — ping me when model_card is in bucket, I'll re-run the license scanner and flag any other policy issues.

samir: FYI @eng-ml: if legal requires blocking, we should add a soft-block in the Console UI for Hosted model toggles — I'll spike that if needed.

alex: noted. last: timeline — aiming for initial internal eval rollout tomorrow if legal greenlights internal eval.
__notes: Generated Slack thread for model onboarding compliance coordination
